description: Space/set currently delegates all mutations to backend with no permission checking. Spec requires: manage_space for top-level fields; manage_roles for addRoles/removeRoles/updateRoles (only roles with position < actor's highest role); manage_channels for channel mutations; manage_members for member mutations; ban permission for SpaceBan operations. Role hierarchy: a member cannot modify roles at or above their own highest role position.
title: Space/set: enforce permissions and role hierarchy
